fields.label: Time Zone
fields.help: Indicate the time zone of your simulated location. Should match the time zone indicated in your inputs (e.g., meteorology).

fields.label: First Day of Simulation
fields.help: Indicate the first day of your simulation (inclusive; i.e., the simulation starts at 0:00)

fields.label: Last Day of Simulation
fields.help: Indicate the last day of your simulation (inclusive; i.e., the simulation ends at 24:00). Typically this is 50 years after the start date.

fields.label: Fraction of Initial Environmental Concentrations to Include
fields.help: Enter the fraction (0 to 1) of starting (background) concentrations This is typically set to 0.

fields.label: Simulation Time-Step (hrs)
fields.help: Enter the interval when the model calculates transfer factors. Typically matches the time-step of your input meteorological data (which is typically 1 hr).

fields.label: Use Steady State Mode
fields.help: Check this box to run a steady-state simulation (requires that all inputs and outputs are not time-varying). This feature is not typically used.

fields.label: Enable Boundary Contributions
fields.help: Check this box if you want the model to incorporate background air concentrations along the simulation's outer boundaries. This feature is not typically used.
